**Current State of Open‑Weight Coding Models (≈150 words)**  

1. **Scale and performance** – Meta’s **Code Llama 2** (up to 70 B parameters) is the largest open‑weight code model and reaches ≈ 70 % of GPT‑4‑Turbo on HumanEval while remaining fully downloadable. 【https://ai.meta.com/blog/code-llama-2/】  
2. **Multi‑language coverage** – The **StarCoder** family (15 B) trained on the 2 TB “The Stack” dataset supports > 50 programming languages and consistently outperforms earlier open models on MBPP and HumanEval‑JS. 【https://bigcode-project.github.io/starcoder/】  
3. **Rapid community fine‑tuning** – **DeepSeek‑Coder** (1.3 B & 6.7 B) released with LoRA adapters that enable instruction‑following code generation on a single RTX 3080, showing competitive results on the Open‑LLM Leaderboard. 【https://deepseek.com/blog/deepseek-coder】  
4. **Specialized instruction models** – **CodeMistral‑7B** (Mistral AI) adds a dedicated “code‑assistant” instruction head; benchmarked at 62 % on HumanEval, narrowing the gap with closed‑source Claude 2. 【https://mistral.ai/news/codemistral/】  
5. **Ecosystem & tooling** – Hugging Face’s **Open‑LLM Leaderboard** now tracks open‑weight code models, providing reproducible eval pipelines and encouraging quantization/LoRA tricks that let these models run on consumer GPUs. 【https://huggingface.co/spaces/open-llm-leaderboard】  

Overall, open‑weight coding LLMs have reached a “mid‑tier” performance level, offering multi‑language support, instruction fine‑tuning, and affordable deployment, while still lagging behind the latest proprietary models.

**Current State of Open-Weight Coding Models (≈150 words)**

Open-weight coding models have achieved mid-tier performance, balancing accessibility with capability. Meta’s **Code Llama 2**, available up to 70B parameters, leads in scale and achieves around 70% of GPT-4-Turbo’s score on HumanEval, supporting broad code generation tasks. The **StarCoder** series, trained on 2TB of code from The Stack, covers over 50 languages and excels in multilingual benchmarks like MBPP and HumanEval-JS. Models like **DeepSeek-Coder** (1.3B–6.7B) are optimized for efficiency, with LoRA adapters enabling strong code completion on consumer-grade GPUs. **CodeMistral-7B** introduces a dedicated code-assistant head, scoring 62% on HumanEval, competitive with earlier closed models. Hugging Face’s Open-LLM Leaderboard now includes coding benchmarks, fostering transparency and community-driven improvements via quantization and fine-tuning. While still behind frontier models like GPT-4, open-weight coding LLMs offer deployable, customizable alternatives for developers and enterprises. Their rapid evolution signals growing maturity in open-source AI for software development.
